Players Committee card image of [[Sabine Wren]] (original printing), game text: “Once per turn, when firing a blaster or rifle, may target for free and add 2 to total weapon destiny. While with an Imperial (or two Rebels), whenever you win a battle here, opponent loses 2 Force. Immune to Hidden Weapons.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/sabinewren.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
